evidence_slices.fact: ONSUD allocates addresses directly to administrative, health and other geographies using the UPRN grid reference and point-in-polygon methodology; Great Britain coverage; six-week release cycle; CSV format.

evidence_slices.reference: National Data Library ONSUD December 2025 Epoch 123 dataset
evidence_slices.fact: Official dataset covers Great Britain as at December 2025, uses AddressBase Epoch 123, and relates each GB address UPRN to current statutory administrative, electoral, health and other statistical geographies.
Dataset UUID is 645d20b9-f059-4e2a-b356-51e35c685c21 and ArcGIS item id is cf1e4c08e78d48e387bcfab837f4e1d0.
